o.text: By surface analysis, oxu- (“to read”) + -yucu (“-er”). Compare Turkmen okyjy.
From Proto-Turkic *bod (“body, stature; self; kin, tribe, etc”).
From Arabic أَسْرَار (ʔasrār) + Classical Persian انگیز (angiz). By surface analysis, əsrar + -əngiz. The first part is the broken plural of sirr (“secret”).
From Russian гранж (granž), ultimately from English grunge.
